headline: RPX GOLD WAWA: 25.50 G/T OVER 4.26M, 135 G/T AU PEAK — ONTARIO PEA ZONE KEEPS EXTENDING IN 12-HOLE CAMPAIGN
source_name: Yahoo Finance / RPX Gold Corp (TSXV: RPX)
snippet: RPX Gold Corp. (TSXV: RPX) reported assays from 12 holes totaling 2,051 metres at its Wawa Gold Project in Ontario, headlined by 25.50 g/t gold over 4.26 metres including a peak interval of 135.00 g/t gold over 0.71 metres — a high-grade shoot that extends the near-surface zone underpinning the project's Preliminary Economic Assessment. Drilling at the Wawa Gold Project is set to continue through late October 2026, with results building toward a completed updated resource estimate.

headline: VISCOUNT MINING K26-08: 267.6 G/T SILVER / 1.72 G/T GOLD OVER 13.4M — KATE-PASSIFLORA TREND ADVANCES AT SILVER CLIFF, COLORADO
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Viscount Mining (TSXV: VML)
snippet: Viscount Mining (TSXV: VML) provided an updated interpretation of drill hole K26-08 at its Silver Cliff Project in Colorado's historic silver district, reporting 267.6 g/t silver and 1.72 g/t gold over 13.4 metres within a fully assayed 184-metre intercept that shows broad precious-metal enrichment throughout. The interpretation advances the Kate-Passiflora high-priority vein trend corridor as the company pushes toward a resource update at a project in a district historically associated with some of Colorado's highest-grade silver production.

headline: LBMA CONFERENCE DELEGATES SEE GOLD AT $5,013, SILVER AT $97 IN 12 MONTHS — INDUSTRY INSIDERS BUY THE DIP
snippet: Delegates at the 2026 London Bullion Market Association Annual Conference — drawn from the world's largest bullion banks, producers and institutional investors — forecast gold at $5,013.30 per ounce and silver at $97 in 12 months, suggesting deep conviction that the current correction is buyable. The survey represents one of the most direct reads on where metal market professionals are positioning ahead of the Fed's final rate moves, with the consensus implying a return to record territory for gold once the tightening cycle ends.

headline: SILVER CRACKS $60 FLOOR — HAWKISH FOMC MINUTES CONFIRM YEAR-END HIKE, BEARS NOW EYE $56 SUPPORT
snippet: Silver slid below the $60 per ounce psychological threshold on October 7 after Federal Reserve minutes from the September FOMC meeting signaled that further rate hikes remain on the table before year-end, extending a three-week precious metals sell-off. Gold dropped to $4,122.73, down 0.98% on the session. Technical analysts are now watching the $56 area as the next meaningful support level for silver, with the broken $60 floor now expected to act as resistance — a development that puts junior silver miners and royalty companies under renewed pressure.

headline: GOLD FALLS TO 2-MONTH LOW THEN BOUNCES BEFORE FOMC — $4,086 TESTED, BUYERS DEFEND BEFORE MINUTES DROP
snippet: Gold fell to its lowest level in roughly two months during the October 7 morning session, touching the $4,086 area, before recovering to the $4,130s before the Federal Reserve released its September meeting minutes at 2 p.m. ET. The intraday bounce off the $4,086 support area is being watched as a potential near-term floor, with the $4,000 psychological level now the key structural support below — a level the World Gold Council has previously flagged as a significant threshold for institutional demand.

headline: DYNASTY GOLD WRAPS 3,000M / 14-HOLE CAMPAIGN AT THUNDERCLOUD — ONTARIO GOLD ASSAYS PENDING, WINTER PROGRAM POSSIBLE
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Dynasty Gold (TSXV: DYG)
snippet: Dynasty Gold Corp. (TSXV: DYG) completed its 2026 drill program at the Thundercloud Gold Project in northwestern Ontario, finishing 14 holes totaling 3,000 metres targeting the main structural gold zone — with all assays pending. A fall or winter drill program may follow depending on results. Thundercloud has previously returned high-grade intercepts including 24.53 g/t gold over 2 metres and sits within the Uchi-English River greenstone belt, a prolific Ontario gold corridor that has produced several multi-million-ounce deposits.

headline: KENORLAND + AURANOVA LAUNCH PHASE 4 AT SOUTH UCHI — ONTARIO GOLD JV TARGETS UCHI BELT DEPTH POTENTIAL
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Kenorland Minerals (TSXV: KLD)
snippet: Kenorland Minerals (TSXV: KLD) and Auranova Resources (TSXV: AURA) commenced Phase 4 diamond drilling at the South Uchi Gold Project in Ontario's Uchi belt, building on Phase 3 results that included 65.45 metres grading 0.34 g/t gold with a higher-grade 21-metre interval at 0.58 g/t. Kenorland is one of the most respected systematic explorers on the TSX Venture Exchange, applying institutional-grade project generation to a belt that trends toward several major deposits — each Phase 4 result will be a meaningful data point for the project's resource potential.

headline: NORTHERN STAR'S VADNAGRA STARTS AS CEO — ELLIOTT PUSHES FOR FULL BOARD OVERHAUL AT $10 BILLION ASX GOLD GIANT
snippet: Suresh Vadnagra — a former Glencore executive and ex-Newcrest Chief Technical and Projects Officer — officially started as Managing Director and CEO of Northern Star Resources (ASX: NST) on October 5, replacing outgoing CEO Stuart Tonkin. Elliott Investment Management, which has grown its stake to 5.6% and put forward six potential director candidates, responded by reiterating that the CEO appointment "does not negate the requirement for broader changes" including a strategic review and board enhancement. The KCGM super-pit mill expansion at Kalgoorlie is simultaneously entering commissioning — a major operational catalyst for the incoming CEO.

headline: QMINES DEPLOYS PONTOON DRILL BENEATH FLOODED MT CHALMERS PIT — NEW COPPER-GOLD DFS ZONE TARGETED IN QUEENSLAND
snippet: QMines (ASX: QML) reported new drill results from pontoon and multi-rig drilling beneath the historic flooded open pit at its Mt Chalmers Copper-Gold Project near Rockhampton, Queensland, with an initial interval of approximately 44 metres grading ~1% copper confirming continuity of the deposit into previously inaccessible ground below the pit floor. QMines already holds a 9.6 million tonne ore reserve at 0.65% copper and secured a A$15 million strategic investment from the Queensland Government's QIC Critical Minerals Fund — the pontoon drilling advances the Definitive Feasibility Study database for a project with a clear path to construction.

headline: "WHEN WILL THE BLEEDING STOP?" — GOLDSEEK WEIGHS GOLD AND SILVER SUPPORT ZONES AFTER THREE-WEEK ROUT
snippet: GoldSeek asks "when will the bleeding stop" in precious metals as gold corrects from the $4,500 area to test $4,100 and silver breaks below $60 in a three-week sell-off driven by elevated yields and Fed rate-hike fears. The analysis weighs key technical support zones — including gold's critical $4,000 floor and silver's $58-56 area — while noting that physical buying from Asian markets has historically cushioned these corrections, and that a divergence between the two metals making new lows could signal the turning point that gold bulls are watching for.
